notes.title: Game Release
notes.content:
Hello,

First and foremost I'd like to thank you all for playing the Demo and trying my game out!

This year been hella crazy, school, divorce, marriage raising kids, looking for jobs not to get to personal. 
Alas I have to delay the release of Apostle 3D I am Aiming for a December release date Right now I'm adding the last of the weapons a few more enemies and the final boss battle. Then I fill the levels with aesthetics and were finished! Sounds like not a big deal but I'm solo developing and this is my first title so cut me a little slack. I hope you guys enjoy my game upon release and if you have any questions or complaints DM me on Twitter @plasma4_U thanks!

--Anarky Studio
